subject: Create Johnny dashboard: Sessions tab with session history
description:
Implement the Sessions tab showing session history and continuity features in Agent Hub.

**Project:** Agent Hub (~/agent-hub/)

**Skills:** Use `/frontend-design` for UI/UX implementation, `/optimized-nextjs-typescript` for patterns.

**Backend:**
- Create session tracking model/table
- Create GET /api/johnny/sessions endpoint
- Create GET /api/johnny/sessions/{id} endpoint for details
- Track session source (claude_code, agent_hub_chat, summitflow_task, agentic)
- Link episodes to sessions

**Frontend:**
- Implement SessionsTab component
- Show session list with metadata (source, date, episode count)
- Session detail view with associated episodes
- Session continuity indicator ("Related to session X")

**Files:**
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/services/johnny/session_tracker.py (new)
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/models/johnny_session.py (new, if needed)
- ~/agent-hub/backend/app/api/johnny.py (new endpoints)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/tabs/SessionsTab.tsx
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/SessionCard.tsx (new)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/components/johnny/SessionDetail.tsx (new)
- ~/agent-hub/frontend/src/lib/johnny-api.ts (new endpoints)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Session tracking implemented
- [ ] GET /api/johnny/sessions returns session list
- [ ] GET /api/johnny/sessions/{id} returns session details
- [ ] Sessions tab displays session list
- [ ] Session detail shows associated episodes
- [ ] Source indicator (Claude Code, Chat, Task, etc.)
- [ ] `dt --check` passes
- [ ] `rebuild.sh` completed (in agent-hub)
- [ ] Verified in browser

**Context Check:** If >= 60%, /compact first. If >= 75%, /commit_it then /compact.

**Completion:** Run /commit_it after verification passes.
